Priya Singh: Following up from last night's postmortem — we scoped the root cause to an async cache GC race that increases eviction pressure. Need 3 quick runbook/playbook updates: explicit triage steps, a clearer escalation matrix (who pages whom and when), and rotating ownership during the remediation sprint.
Jo Park: Agreed. We should insert an "isolate shard" step before any full failover so we don't cause noisy neighbor effects.
Carlos Mendes: I'll own the triage step edits and the runnable commands section. Tentative due date 2026-03-29.
Priya Singh: Please include concrete one-liners; oncall will copy/paste under pressure. Example snippets to include in the runbook: 
```
# list hot pods by restart count
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=serving -o jsonpath='{.items[?(@.status.containerStatuses[0].restartCount>5)].metadata.name}'
# temporarily exclude pod from routing
rbctl routing set --model my-model --exclude-pod PODNAME
```

Jo Park: Also add a quick check for eviction rate and prefix-size:
```
curl -sS http://metrics.internal/kvcache?model=my-model | jq '.evictions_per_minute, .prefix_size_mb'
```
Threshold suggestion: evictions_per_minute > 80 => start triage; >200 => page runtime lead.
oncall-bot: PD-889 created for runbook follow-up (linked to postmortem).
runbook-bot: Created task RB-4410 "Add cache-GC triage steps + shard isolation + escalation matrix" and assigned to Carlos Mendes. Due 2026-03-29.
Carlos Mendes: Plan for the edit: 1) add triage checklist 2) add runnable commands + exact thresholds 3) add revert snippets 4) add quick decision tree for failover vs shard isolation. I'll push to a guarded branch and request a staging dry-run.
Priya Singh: Please also add a "pattern detection" section linking previous incidents 2389001111 and 2390002222 so PMs and SREs can see recurrence.
Jo Park: I'll take reviewer duty and add the revert commands (kubectl rollout undo + rbctl route restore). Also propose we rotate the oncall runbook owner weekly for the next 6 weeks to spread knowledge.
Carlos Mendes: Quick QA plan: reproduce in staging by lowering GC_threshold on a test shard, validate runbook steps, and mark steps as "verified" in the runbook.
Priya Singh: Recap owners: Carlos -> runbook edits + staging dry-run (due 2026-03-29). Jo -> review + revert snippets (due 2026-03-27). Priya -> incident linkage + escalation matrix drafting (due 2026-03-26). runbook-bot -> create RB-4410 (done). oncall-bot -> keep PD-889 open until runbook changes are live.
Jo Park: I'll add the weekly owner rotation schedule in the runbook appendix.
Carlos Mendes: Will open the guarded branch later today and ping this thread with PR link.
Priya Singh: Thanks all. Please drop ticket/PR links here as you create them so I can update the postmortem action table. :white_check_mark:
